title: Auto-regressive Neural Quantum State Sampling for Selected Configuration Interaction
summary: Accurate ground-state energy calculations remain a central challenge in quantum chemistry due to the exponential scaling of the many-body Hilbert space. Variational Monte Carlo and variational quantum eigensolvers offer promising ansatz optimization approaches but face limitations in convergence as well as hardware constraints. We introduce a particular Selected Configuration Interaction (SCI) algorithm that uses auto-regressive neural networks (ARNNs) to guide subspace expansion for ground-state search.
